name: Mortis Rituals — 1 Basic — Eyes of the Grave

system.description: You can visit visions and terrifying insights of preordained doom upon your target. You must possess some item sympathetically linked to the victim and ritually destroy it over the course of two full hours while chanting incantations. You may expend one or more Social Traits during the incantation to make the experience more terrifying. Each night, over the course of the next week, the target experiences one harrowing vision (one more per Social Trait spent during casting). The Storyteller determines the time and content of these visions; each time a character receives one, she must make a Courage Test (difficulty five Traits) or be incapacitated with terror for three turns.
